title: Mario Coin
blurb: Forty years of players are neurologically conditioned to feel rewarded by this exact blip, which is why it is comedy gold when attached to something worthless. Koji Kondo built the coin sound to be short, bright and endlessly repeatable, so that a row of them becomes rhythm rather than noise — genuinely clever design for hardware with almost no audio channels to spare. Apply it to a penny found in a coat pocket, a participation certificate, or an offer of exposure in lieu of payment. The gold standard of reward sounds, quite literally.
origin: The coin collect from Super Mario Bros. (Nintendo, 1985).
